card.name: Linking words in label population statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the, to, are, or the word population in stock label phrases. Typical settings are the Geriatric Use and pregnancy risk statements, just before a patient group or number.

modes.label: Geriatric Use opener
modes.description: The word of or the right after 'Geriatric Use Of' and before the count of patients.
modes.example: Geriatric Use Of the total number<< of>> patients in clinical studies of calcipot

modes.label: Pregnancy risk wording
modes.description: The word population or to in fixed pregnancy risk sentences.
modes.example: The background risk of major birth defects and miscarriage for the indicated<< population>> is unknown.
